body:
If I use the scenario of the #2404 in https://deploy-preview-2900--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default

* initial search: no bounds
* set min bound to 1500 (around): min bound = 1500
* type I: query = I, min bound = 1500
* type K: query = IK, min bound = 180
* remove one character: query = I, min bound = 180

We can see that this does not solve #2404
